preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner address)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call deprecate() with a malicious upgradedAddress that implements UpgradedStandardToken interface. The malicious contract should override transfer/transferFrom functions to allow arbitrary token minting or theft. Then perform token transfers through the deprecated contract to execute malicious logic.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The TetherToken contract has an upgrade mechanism that allows the owner to deprecate the contract and delegate all token operations to a new contract implementing UpgradedStandardToken interface. Once deprecated, functions like transfer() call the upgraded contract's transferByLegacy() method. A malicious upgraded contract can implement these methods to mint arbitrary tokens or steal funds.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank. 2. Deploy a malicious upgraded contract that implements the required interface but mints tokens to the attacker. 3. Call deprecate() with the malicious contract address. 4. Call transfer() which will delegate to the malicious contract's transferByLegacy() method, minting tokens to the attacker.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner (we need to find the owner address first). 2. Deploy MaliciousUpgradedToken contract. 3. Call deprecate(maliciousContract). 4. Call transfer() on the TetherToken contract, which will delegate to malicious contract. 5. The malicious contract's transferByLegacy() will mint tokens to the attacker.
